Debug a fixed-base three-joint robot manipulator in the x-z plane, not a biped.
The controller plans Cartesian waypoints, solves inverse kinematics and runs joint PD at 200 Hz.
Find one causal code/config location from the frames, pixel gaps, controller log and numbered code.
Every claim cites its source: frame K1..K4, measurement at a sent key-frame time,
log t=... from the provided table, or code file:line. Cite at least one key frame and one log tick.
No contact truth from the simulator is supplied. Mask contact means gap <= 2 pixels in this side view.
The cause is one real file, function/config key, and line range <=30 lines. Cite the exact setting
when a configuration value is the cause. Explain alternatives ruled out by the evidence.
Do not write a patch. Suggest the smallest causal logic or configuration fix.
The fixed robot must still reach the green target. Return JSON matching the schema.
plain has three short everyday sentences (camera, robot, why); confidence is your estimate.

===== brain.py (45 lines) =====
   1| """Deterministic Cartesian waypoints, elbow-up inverse kinematics and 200 Hz PD."""
   2| import math
   3| import pathlib
   4| import tomllib
   5| 
   6| import numpy as np
   7| 
   8| BASE = (-0.38, 0.16)
   9| L1, L2, TOOL = 0.36, 0.34, 0.06
  10| START = (-0.10, 0.22)
  11| 
  12| 
  13| def ik(x, z):
  14|     x, z = x - BASE[0] - TOOL, z - BASE[1]
  15|     c = (x*x + z*z - L1*L1 - L2*L2) / (2*L1*L2)
  16|     if not -1 <= c <= 1:
  17|         raise ValueError(f"unreachable waypoint: {x}, {z}")
  18|     elbow = -math.acos(c)
  19|     shoulder = math.atan2(z, x) - math.atan2(L2*math.sin(elbow), L1+L2*math.cos(elbow))
  20|     return np.array([shoulder, elbow, -shoulder-elbow])
  21| 
  22| 
  23| class Brain:
  24|     def __init__(self, folder, target):
  25|         cfg = tomllib.loads((pathlib.Path(folder)/"brain.toml").read_text())
  26|         self.clearance = cfg["planner"]["clearance"]
  27|         self.kp, self.kd = cfg["pd"]["kp"], cfg["pd"]["kd"]
  28|         self.target = (float(target[0]), float(target[2]))
  29| 
  30|     def waypoint(self, t):
  31|         x0, z0 = START
  32|         x1, z1 = self.target
  33|         lift = max(z0, z1) - self.clearance
  34|         points = [(0., (x0,z0)), (0.5, (x0,z0)), (1.3, (x0,lift)),
  35|                   (3.4, (x1,lift)), (4.3, (x1,z1)), (6., (x1,z1))]
  36|         for i, ((ta,a),(tb,b)) in enumerate(zip(points,points[1:])):
  37|             if t <= tb:
  38|                 u = max(0., min(1., (t-ta)/(tb-ta)))
  39|                 s = u*u*(3-2*u)
  40|                 return ik(*(a[j]+s*(b[j]-a[j]) for j in range(2))), i
  41|         return ik(x1,z1), len(points)-2
  42| 
  43|     def tick(self, t, q, dq):
  44|         targets, waypoint = self.waypoint(t)
  45|         return self.kp*(targets-q)-self.kd*dq, targets, waypoint
